table.name: TLGNR_CURRENCY_BS
table.description: Currencies. List of currencies which can be handled by Logon, and is a sub-set of the currencies known in SAP.

column.name: CURRENCY_CD
column.description: PK. CHF, EUR, etc. SAP knows currency codes of length 5, therefore also allowing 5, although in practice only 3 are used.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
